homepage_faq.q1.name: How long does it take to restore an old wedding video?
homepage_faq.q1.text: Standard turnaround is 48-72 hours. For complex restorations (heavy damage, multiple tapes), it may take 5-7 business days. Rush delivery is available for an additional fee.
homepage_faq.q10.name: How does pricing work for multiple services?
homepage_faq.q10.text: Bundle discounts apply when you book 2+ services on the same project: 10% off for 2 services, 15% off for 3 services, 20% off for 5+ services. Discounts are applied automatically. The first-customer discount (mention "FIRST" in your request) gives an extra 20% off your first service, stacking up to a 30% maximum.
homepage_faq.q2.name: What video formats do you accept?
homepage_faq.q2.text: We accept VHS, VHS-C, DV, Hi8, MiniDVD, 8mm, 16mm film, and all modern digital formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV).
homepage_faq.q3.name: How do I send my video files?
homepage_faq.q3.text: After submitting your request, we'll send you a secure upload link. Files are encrypted and deleted 30 days after delivery.
homepage_faq.q4.name: Can you restore a video with missing audio?
homepage_faq.q4.text: Yes. Our AI can reconstruct audio from visual cues and ambient sound.
homepage_faq.q5.name: What's your refund policy?
homepage_faq.q5.text: If you're not satisfied with the result, we'll revise it twice at no extra cost. Full refund is available if we can't meet your requirements after revisions.
homepage_faq.q6.name: How do you handle my personal footage and privacy?
homepage_faq.q6.text: Your footage is stored encrypted on secure US-based servers. Files are automatically deleted 30 days after delivery. You can request earlier deletion at any time by emailing privacy@weddingai.video. We never share your footage with third parties without written consent.
homepage_faq.q7.name: What about AI safety and bias in your processing?
homepage_faq.q7.text: We use commercial-grade AI models with safety guardrails. A human filmmaker reviews every output before delivery. We do not generate deepfakes of real people.
homepage_faq.q8.name: Who owns the final video and can I use it commercially?
homepage_faq.q8.text: You own the final video. We retain a non-exclusive license to use anonymized excerpts in our portfolio unless you explicitly opt out in writing. You may use the video for personal, social media, and commercial purposes (e.g., selling as part of a wedding planning business) — no additional permission or fees required.
homepage_faq.q9.name: Do you offer rush delivery?
homepage_faq.q9.text: Yes. Most services offer 48-hour rush delivery for an additional 30-50% fee, depending on the service. Check the service page or mention it in your quote request and we will confirm availability.

pricing_faq.q1.name: Why is the price a range instead of a flat fee?
pricing_faq.q1.text: Every project is different. A 5-minute VHS tape and a 3-hour 4K wedding film are not the same work. We quote based on footage length, complexity, and turnaround. The $9.9 starting price is the entry point for each service; the final quote reflects your project's actual scope.
pricing_faq.q2.name: Do you charge hourly?
pricing_faq.q2.text: Never. We charge per project. You'll know the exact price before we start — and the price won't change unless you add scope.
pricing_faq.q3.name: Are there hidden fees?
pricing_faq.q3.text: No. File delivery, format conversion, and 2 rounds of revisions are included in every project. The only time the price changes is if you ask for additional work after delivery.
pricing_faq.q4.name: What payment methods do you accept?
pricing_faq.q4.text: All major credit cards (via Stripe), PayPal, and bank transfer for projects over $1,000. Invoices are sent on delivery; payment is due within 14 days.
pricing_faq.q5.name: Can I get a refund if I'm not happy?
pricing_faq.q5.text: Yes. Two free revisions are included with every service. If after revisions you're still not happy, we offer a full refund. We've processed over 500 projects and refunded fewer than 5.
pricing_faq.q6.name: Do you offer discounts for non-profits or destination weddings?
pricing_faq.q6.text: Sometimes. If your wedding serves a charitable cause (e.g. a vow-renewal fundraiser) or you have a tight story to tell, mention it in the form — we'll see what we can do.
